yapping.definition: Form of yap (gerund participle present): Of a small dog, to bark.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yare.definition: Form of yair (alternative): An enclosure for catching salmon as the tide ebbs.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawned.definition: Form of yawn (participle past): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawns.definition: Form of yawn (indicative present singular third-person): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yearling.definition: An animal that is between one and two years old; one that is in its second year (but not yet two full years old).

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year’s.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelling.definition: Form of yell (gerund participle present): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellowed.definition: Form of yellow (participle past): To become yellow or yellower.

yellowskinned.definition: A yellow-skinned person, often of Southeast Asian or East Asian ethnic origin.

yer.definition: Form of yeah (UK pronunciation-spelling slang): Form of year (colloquial pronunciation-spelling): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yessir.definition: Term of address to a male; mate; buddy.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yesterdays.definition: Form of yesterday (plural): The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yiddish.definition: Of or pertaining to the Yiddish language.

yodling.definition: Form of yodle (gerund participle present): Form of yodel (archaic): To sing (a song) in such a way that the voice fluctuates rapidly between the normal chest voice and falsetto.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

yonkers.definition: Form of yonker (plural): Form of younker (obsolete): A young man; a lad, youngster.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

york’s.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

yous.definition: Form of you (dialectal plural): The name of the Latin script letter U/u.

yout.definition: Form of youth (Multicultural-London-English New-York-City pronunciation-spelling): The quality or state of being young.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youth’s.definition: The quality or state of being young.

yowling.definition: Form of yowl (gerund participle present): Utter a yowl.

yump.definition: To leave the ground briefly when driving over a ridge at high speed.

yumps.definition: Form of yump (indicative present singular third-person): To leave the ground briefly when driving over a ridge at high speed.

ze.definition: The name of the Cyrillic script letter З / з.

zenith.definition: The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zinc.definition: A chemical element (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30, a blue-silvery metal that is slightly brittle at room temperature and tarnishes slightly in moist air.

zinnia.definition: Any of several brightly coloured flowering plants, of the genus Zinnia, native to tropical America; old maid.

zis.definition: Form of this (not-comparable pronunciation-spelling): To the degree or extent indicated.

zo.definition: Form of dzo (alternative): A hybrid of a yak and a domesticated cow, especially a male.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

zooming.definition: Form of zoom (gerund participle present): To move fast with a humming noise.
